bibliographic.title: The Darien Gap
bibliographic.author: Kurmi Xochitl, influencia indebida, Gaz
bibliographic.description:
Choose your own doom as survivors of this perilous trek.

Patients who have survived describe everything from falls off cliffs to drowning in rivers, and from kidnappings to sexual abuse.

The Darien Gap, a treacherous jungle teeming with dangers, has become a harrowing passage for countless migrants seeking a better life.
